messages:
arjun: Heads-up — planning an ingest replay for EU-nightly window to recompute aggregates for 2026-02-28 -> 2026-03-02 because of late telemetry. Need to coordinate quotas + routing safeguards. Can we avoid stomping realtime pipelines?

maya: +1. How big is the payload? rough estimate ~120M events across 3 days. main risk is spike to the aggregator and metrics DB.

sam: If we run full concurrency we'll blow through per-tenant quotas. Suggest running with concurrency=8, per-shard pause=200ms, and use routing policy `prefer-cold` to send to cheaper pool. Also add tenant-exclude list for high-traffic customers. :thumbsup:

tess: Can we use the reprocess framework's safe-run mode? It supports `dry_run=true` then `throttle=0.1`. Also can add a dashboard panel to watch commit lag. https://console.internal/redwood/dashboards/replay-health

maya: We should add a temporary quota override token that auto-revokes after 2h. Ops can create via `/quota grant --temp`. Also add fallback to route replay tasks into `low-priority` queue when aggregate service latency > 2s.

ingest-bot: job 1887654321-replay started by arjun — mode=dry_run throttle=0.05 shards=16

sam: One more: update rollouts console to show replay in "maintenance" mode so oncall knows. Also set an alert if aggregate skew > 3% for 10m (to auto-pause).

arjun: Will do. Plan: start dry run tonight 02:00 UTC, monitor for 2h, then move to live with concurrency 12 and throttle 0.2 if stable. Posting runbook snippet:

```
replay run --start=2026-02-28 --end=2026-03-02 \\
  --mode=dry_run --concurrency=8 --throttle=0.05 \\
  --exclude-tenants=tier1,partner-x
```

tess: I'll add dashboard panel and an SLO guard with auto-pauser. I'll also wire a small status tile into the rollouts UX so PMs can see replay progress.

maya: One ask: ensure recompute doesn't delete old aggregates until we validate signature counts. add `--retention-buffer=24h` to run.

sam: ack. ops oncall FYI @tess @arjun :eyes:

ingest-bot: job 1887654321-replay dry_run finished — processed 2.4M events, peak qps 120, avg latency 450ms

arjun: Results look promising — scheduling live run 02:30 UTC with concurrency=12, throttle=0.1, auto-revoke token at +2h. Will post status updates here. :thumbsup:
